old_result.onset_definition: onset_t = first window where SepsisLabel == 1 (instantaneous label transition)
old_result.lookahead_window_handling: Alerts occurring in the 4h lookahead period (S_next4==1 prior to SepsisLabel==1) were included as valid pre-transition early warning alerts.

current_result.onset_definition: onset_t = first window where (SepsisLabel == 1 OR S_next4 == 1)
current_result.lookahead_window_handling: onset_t was shifted 4 hours earlier to the first S_next4==1 window. Alerts occurring between S_next4==1 and SepsisLabel==1 fell after onset_t, truncating the valid alert window by 4 hours for 7-12 patients.

filesystem_order_claim_status: REJECTED. File sorting (sorted vs unsorted glob.glob) has ZERO effect on patient sensitivity (79.93% in both cases). The claim in earlier audit reports that filesystem enumeration order caused the shift is disproven.
